scope: Real system font-scale changes on the identified Googlebook with the 0.2.0 diagnostic APK. Injected vertical scrolling reached four controls at 1.3 and 2.0; Refresh was invoked and observed. Not product or accessibility qualification.
buildBoundary: Same 0.2.0 source/APK and 17-test build as the earlier window/process experiments. This run predates the separate 0.3.0 engagement implementation; no engagement result is claimed.

time.clockBoundary: Host command records and device timestamps are separate reported clocks; no cross-clock timing or latency inference.

actionProvenance: Primary agent used explicitly targeted ADB/official Android CLI on the real device. Font setting was temporarily changed for the current user and restored exactly. Pointer/touch actions were injected and used freshly inspected own-app bounds.

setup.baselineBoundary: The 100% screenshot and marker layout precede the explicit marker change. Created report revision19 precedes the resize. Narrow 100% report geometry is independently present after setting restoration at revision97; no full-control-at-once baseline claim.
